ABOUT

Who I am

I am an Electronics and Communication Engineering student at Bapuji Institute of Engineering and Technology, Davangere.

My primary interests are Embedded Systems, Electronics and Software development. I have hands-on experience with microcontrollers, embedded programming, sensor interfacing, communication protocols and Python-based development.

I enjoy building practical projects that combine hardware, firmware and software to solve real-world problems.
